title: Rio's Lemonade Stall
note: Zungga pilot episode 1 for Class 3–5 (Tamil Nadu + Karnataka state boards). Built by make_story.py from SCRIPT.md.

scenes.title: Scene 1
scenes.narration: It was the hottest day of the whole summer. The sun was shining, the roads were sizzling, and everyone in the colony was thirsty. That is when Rio had a big idea.

scenes.title: Scene 2
scenes.narration: Lemonade! Ice-cold lemonade! I will open the coolest shop in the whole colony!

scenes.title: Scene 3
scenes.narration: A shop needs things to sell, Rio. What do we have to buy first?

scenes.title: Scene 4
scenes.narration: So they went shopping. Lemons cost thirty rupees. Sugar cost twenty rupees. And paper cups cost twenty rupees.

scenes.title: Scene 5
scenes.narration: Thirty plus twenty plus twenty. We spent seventy rupees.

scenes.title: Scene 6
scenes.narration: No problem! We have twelve cups of lemonade. Ten rupees a cup. We will be rich!

scenes.title: Scene 7
scenes.narration: Arre, lemonade on such a hot day? Wonderful! One cup for me, young man.

scenes.title: Scene 8
scenes.narration: One by one, five people bought a cup. Fifty rupees went into Rio's box.

scenes.title: Scene 9
scenes.narration: But then, nobody came. The sun got hotter, the ice melted, and the lemonade turned warm.

scenes.title: Scene 10
scenes.narration: Wait. We spent seventy rupees, and we only got fifty. Did we… lose money?!

scenes.title: Scene 11
scenes.narration: Seventy minus fifty is twenty. We lost twenty rupees.

scenes.title: Scene 12
scenes.narration: Friends, help me! Look carefully at the street. Where is everybody going? Say it out loud!

scenes.title: Scene 13
scenes.narration: Yes! To the park! Everyone is going to the park.

cards.text: 🎈 Everyone is going to the PARK! 🎈

scenes.title: Scene 14
scenes.narration: So what should I do? One: shout louder, right here. Two: take my stall to the park. Three: close my shop and go home. Show me with your fingers: one, two or three!

cards.text: Take the stall to the park

scenes.title: Scene 15
scenes.narration: Two! Two! Go where the people are! And I will paint a giant smiling lemon sign!

scenes.title: Scene 16
scenes.narration: So they added fresh ice, put up Mira's sign, and moved the stall to the park gate.

scenes.title: Scene 17
scenes.narration: Two cups please! My grandchildren are very thirsty!

scenes.title: Scene 18
scenes.narration: Now a maths question! I have seven cups left. Each cup is ten rupees. If I sell them all, how much money will I get? Count with me!

count.question: How much money will Rio get?

scenes.title: Scene 19
scenes.narration: Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy! Seventy rupees! Plus the fifty we already had makes one hundred and twenty.

scenes.title: Scene 20
scenes.narration: We spent seventy. One hundred and twenty minus seventy is fifty. We made fifty rupees of profit!

scenes.title: Scene 21
scenes.narration: Profit! If you said two, you think like a real business person. And if you counted seventy, you are a maths star!

scenes.title: Scene 22
scenes.narration: Remember: before you sell, count what you spend. Then sell where your customers are!

scenes.title: Scene 23
scenes.narration: Now it is YOUR turn! Pick one mission, do it in real life, and ask a grown-up at home to approve it.

items.text: Do 10 lemon-squeeze jumps! (jump + squeeze your hands)
Help a grown-up put the shopping away. Find 3 price tags!
Draw your own shop sign with a price on it!

scenes.title: Scene 24
scenes.narration: Next time, a new lemonade stall opens right across the road, selling lemonade for only five rupees! What will Rio do?
